relationships.target_anchor: ← (left-pointing arrow beside cancelled 'Bhasmajābāla Upaniṣat. See Jābāla Upaniṣat')
relationships.evidence: On facing fol. 169 a left-pointing arrow sits at about the same height as this entry. It is next to a cancelled heading with a similar title in the alphabetical position for 'Bhasma-'. This suggests the entry belongs at that point in the sequence.

uncertainties: The title is cursive. It may read 'Bhasmajābāla' or 'Bharmajātāla'; the middle letters are not secure.
The initial letter of the shelfmark could be capital or lowercase 'c'.

block_disposition.explanation: Right-column date/extent/lines/script data on the same line as b005.

page_annotations: Apart from the listed blocks, the page is otherwise unwritten.
Faint mirrored show-through of fol. 168 recto is visible across the page. It is not transcribed.
There are small ink dots mid-page (c.[1140,2020]) and lower left (c.[490,4110]); they carry no text.
Fragments of facing fol. 169 beyond the gutter are excluded. These are 'for Bhaviṣya…', 'd. 365(4)…', 'cat. s. √…', '(Ṣaṣṭīvratakathā…', 'Bhaviṣyapu…' and an arrow '←'.
unresolved_relationships: The referents of 'transfer m.D.', 'ā/' and '(see MS)' are unresolved. They may concern the single entry on this page or its transfer to the fol. 169 sequence.

coverage.finding: The folio label '168' is followed by a raised 'b' at the top left. A small dot or point beside the 'b' may be punctuation or part of the letter. This is noted as unresolved, not changed.
The two-line pencil note at about [1710,580,240,160] reads 'transfer' over 'm.D.'. The second line is faint and remains uncertain.
'ā/' is at about [2160,600,110,130]. The macron and the long oblique stroke are visible.
'(see MS)' is written slanting upward at about [2290,370,240,160]. It is legible.
The tick in the left margin and the main entry line are captured. The cursive title remains uncertain.
The right-column data 'n.d.: 10: 7/9: D.' is on the same ruled line as b005. It is correctly merged into r005.

unresolved.next_check: Compare the letter forms with secure 's', 'b' and 't' elsewhere in the same hand.

review.boundary_review: Text beyond the gutter at x>c.3140 belongs to fol. 169 and is excluded. That text comprises 'for Bhaviṣya…', 'd. 365(4)…', 'cat. s. √…', the bracketed pencil 'Ṣaṣṭīvratakathā… Bhaviṣyapu…' and the arrow '←' at about [3320,3840]. Conversely, '7/9: D.' visible at the left edge of the fol. 169 image is this page's b006 seen across the opening, not a separate record. Mirrored show-through of the fol. 168 entries is not transcribed. The link between the fol. 169 arrow and r005 is probable, not secure.

region_review.bottom: Contains the single entry line at y≈3700-3830 with its tick, and a dot at about [500,4120]. The remaining lines are blank apart from show-through.
region_review.left_margin: Contains the tick before C.17(3). No other marginal writing.
region_review.right_margin: Contains no target-page writing. The facing-page fragments beyond the gutter are excluded.
region_review.interlinear: No interlinear additions or cancellations found on the target page.
